scope: One existing leading program: external controlled HS evidence, missingness/denominator recovery and the resulting HHD endpoint-to-claim interpretation. No broad new screen.
selection_rationale: Closed BLU claim-mapping, zinc, SLC6A6 and HHD supplement searches were excluded. Bounded DYN101/PIK3C2B and enasidenib triage did not reveal an actionable new primary delta. Readable randomized exact-cream HS results and the official SAP could resolve a concrete patient-benefit interpretation for rank 3. This is a bounded value-of-information choice, not an exhaustive ranking.

bounded_triage.lane: DYN101 human PD and PIK3C2B context
bounded_triage.outcome: No newly recovered decision-changing primary result in the bounded pass; prior UNITE-CNM and epilepsy evidence already audited. EU results attachment reader did not expose synopsis content.

bounded_triage.lane: Enasidenib current human and formulation evidence
bounded_triage.outcome: No new comparative bioavailability or patient outcome recovered; inaccessible primary full text and previously audited patent examples did not justify repeating the closed CNS search.
Selected; official results JSON and visible SAP recovered, permitting actual denominators, intervals, withdrawals and phase-specific safety to replace summary-only ambiguity.

completion_rule: Complete bounded primary-document reconciliation, explicit claim decision, independent review and expected-head main publication with fresh commit/tree/manifest verification. Full journal article/supplement, participant-level data and implemented-analysis code remain unread.

delta: Recovered complete official NCT05635838 results and the visible official SAP. One randomized HS cohort has 34/35 controlled-period starters, 24/32 completers and 10/3 noncompleters. Lesion endpoint tables display N24/32 and pain/itch N23/22; those are not verified full longitudinal-model contributor counts.

The reported primary AN-count LS difference is -1.20 (95% CI -2.21 to -0.18; P=.0215). Pain +0.19 (-1.27 to 1.64) and itch +0.94 (-0.52 to 2.40) do not establish superiority, harm or equivalence. Overlapping lesion endpoints are not independent patient-benefit confirmations.

Preserve official registry LS estimates separately from sponsor symptom/IHS4 summaries with incompletely specified estimators. The registry describes MMRM but labels the structured method ANCOVA. Planned all-randomized analysis, weekly diary rules, actual endpoint availability and missingness robustness are separate facts.

Recover DBVC TEAEs 13/34 versus 15/35 and grade>=3 events 0/34 versus 2/35; OLE TEAEs 8/24 versus 15/32 and grade>=3 events 0/24 versus 3/32. Both OLE groups receive active cream. Pooled active SAEs 2/66 include crossover recipients and are not an independent randomized comparison with vehicle 1/35.

Add seven explicit endpoint-to-claim decisions while retaining the Round 7 clinical-proof requirements, Round 10 comparator choices and Round 13 optional-model limits. No imported HS response probability, HHD endpoint threshold, sample size, duration or exposure clearance. Retain rank 3, 10 planning points and the unchanged 100-point queue.

allocation.unit: planning-effort points; not dollars,success probabilities or spending

queue.scope: Darier comparator; not an S-tier or exclusive asset
selective target discovery; exact W7 deprioritized

activity_boundary: Published-document research, deterministic content checks and repository publication only. No outreach, purchases, recruitment, experiments, simulations or material receipt.

reopen_for: Primary correction resolving model/population or source-specific estimate discrepancies
New primary HHD evidence that changes benefit, comparator or exposure decisions

interpretation_limits: HS and HHD are different diseases; the 69-person HS cohort adds no HHD-treated person or HHD effect estimate.
Displayed week 16 endpoint Ns do not identify complete repeated-measures contributor counts.
The SAP is planned methods; upload/date and registry model labels do not prove full implementation or pre-lock finalization.
Primary P=.0215 also meets.05; the planned.10 convention does not negate the positive result.
Uncertain symptoms do not prove harm, equivalence, clinically trivial effect or futility.
Overlapping lesion outcomes and multiple reports of one cohort are not independent replications.
Sponsor and registry estimates differ and are not pooled or assigned an unverified estimator explanation.
All-active selected extension cannot estimate contemporaneous vehicle-controlled maintenance; an early-versus-delayed strategy estimand is a separate question.
Grade>=3 is not serious-event status; pooled crossover exposure groups are not independent randomized safety arms.
No HHD threshold, duration, sample size, safety margin, asset promotion or new execution authorization follows.
